mentions.name: FizzBuzz.md
mentions.description: FizzBuzz.md is a take-home coding challenge platform for technical hiring. Applicants access challenges via an API and can send questions and submissions to configurable email addresses, so the addresses aren't exposed directly, reducing spam. It was built as a better version of an in-house solution for evaluating engineering applicants instead of reviewing resumes.
mentions.problem: Resume screening is tedious and, as Joel Spolsky points out, resumes are not great indications of technical ability.
mentions.audience: Hiring managers and startups screening engineering candidates
mentions.source_excerpt: FizzBuzz.md is a better version of the solution I built for work. It lets applicants send questions and submissions to configurable email addresses via API so the email addresses aren't exposed directly. (Less spam, FTW)
